tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind everything. Never a card surface.

tokens.name: layer-01
tokens.usage: First stacked surface: cards, panels, dialogs (Carbon layer-01).

tokens.name: layer-02
tokens.usage: Second stacked surface: a panel nested inside a layer-01 card, sidebars, inset boxes.

tokens.name: layer-03
tokens.usage: Third stacked surface: a control or well inside a layer-02 panel. Hovered rows.

tokens.name: inverse-layer
tokens.usage: Surface that flips against the theme: snackbars, tooltips (Material inverse-surface).

tokens.name: on-inverse-layer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse-layer.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop. Apply at about 40% opacity.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on bg and layers.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: The one secondary text level: captions, timestamps, helper text. Do not add a third grey; change weight or size instead.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers: table rules, section separators (Carbon border-subtle).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines and any border that must read as interactive. 3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single most important action or data point on a screen. Fills for primary buttons, selected indicators.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-container
tokens.usage: Tonal fill for selected items, chips, active nav (Material primary-container).

tokens.name: on-accent-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-container.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links and icon-only primary actions (Primer accent-fg). Use this, not accent, for accent-coloured text.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited inline links.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring. Deliberately not the accent so it stays visible on accent fills (Carbon focus).

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Quiet tonal fill for secondary buttons and filter chips.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Warm clay tonal fill for callouts and decorative emphasis. Use rarely.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: on-emphasis
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any filled -emphasis colour except warning-emphasis.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: passing checks, confirmations.

tokens.name: success-emphasis
tokens.usage: Filled success button or badge. Text on it is on-emphasis.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Success banner and tag background. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-emphasis
tokens.usage: Filled warning badge. Text on it is on-warning-emphasis (dark), never white.

tokens.name: on-warning-emphasis
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-emphasis.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Warning banner and tag background. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive icons, field validation messages.

tokens.name: danger-emphasis
tokens.usage: Filled destructive button. Text on it is on-emphasis.

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Error banner and field-error background. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons.

tokens.name: info-emphasis
tokens.usage: Filled info badge. Text on it is on-emphasis.

tokens.name: info-container
tokens.usage: Info banner and tag background. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: done-fg
tokens.usage: Completed or merged lifecycle state (Primer done). Distinct from success: use for things that have finished a lifecycle.

tokens.name: done-emphasis
tokens.usage: Filled done or merged badge. Text on it is on-emphasis.

tokens.name: done-container
tokens.usage: Done banner and tag background. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: neutral-emphasis
tokens.usage: Closed, archived or neutral lifecycle badge. Text on it is on-emphasis.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Hairline gap: icon-to-text inside a dense tag (Carbon spacing-01).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between closely related inline elements and between related form fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact component padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card and panel padding. The most common step.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards and between form sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between distinct content groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page header to page content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level section spacing.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero and top-level section breaks, wide-layout page margins.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed images, dense data tables, Carbon-style productive screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: inputs, selects, badges (Primer default control radius).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default for buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, prominent cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Expressive hero containers. Marketing and editorial only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, switches. Not every rectangle.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting raised surface: cards that need lift.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.
